title: If the AI coach comes back, it has no health safety rules and no way to report a bad reply, which Google Play asks of AI apps
what: The coach is switched off today. Its instructions to the AI tell it to coach training and estimate meal calories, but say nothing about pain, injury, medical conditions, eating problems or young members, and never ask it to say a calorie number is a rough guess. The chat also has no way for a member to report a harmful or wrong AI reply.
expected: Before the coach is switched on: the AI is told to stay out of medical advice and point to a doctor for pain or illness, to say photo calories are estimates, and each AI reply has a report button, as Google Play asks of apps that make AI content.
how_often: only if the coach is switched on
fix_line: Add safety rules to the coach instructions and a report button on AI replies before switching the coach on
